newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albanian unions to strike over price hikes.
newsitem.headline: Albanian unions to strike over price hikes.

text.p: Albanian trade unions will hold a 24-hour strike on Friday in support of their demand for government compensation to offset rising bread and fuel prices, union leader Estref Mersinaj said on Thursday.
Mersinaj, who heads the strike committee of Albania's Independent Trade Union, said a one-hour warning strike on September 16 had failed to bring the desired results.
Bread prices have been a sensitive issue since Albania toppled its hardline communist regime in 1990. More than 40 people were killed in a wave of food riots in 1991.
President Sali Berisha's ruling Democrats liberalised prices for bread, gas and kerosene in July, triggering a 30 percent rise in prices.
Up to 200,000 public sector workers took part in the September protest and unions predict the same number will join Friday's strike.
Sectors likely to be affected by the walk-out include education, energy, health care, telecommunications, transport and light industry, unions said.
